title: North Star handbook lesson/1
$comment: Contract: DESIGN.md, Source of truth and Compounding loop fields. Canonical home and widening: lead ruling https://github.com/seathatflowsinourveins/northstar/issues/15#issuecomment-6507541956, read 2026-10-29. The existing 15 required fields, including nullable sample_size, stay unchanged; parameter-change metadata is optional. Mirrors src/northstar_trading/research/handbook/core.py validation. Use core.schema_validator() to assert custom formats (JSON Schema 2020-12 validation sections 6.1.1 and 7); generic validators may ignore them. Cross-record id/identity uniqueness and ordered supersession, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite JSON tokens are log/parser checks, not single-record assertions. All $ref targets are local; the $id is an identifier, not a network resource.

area.$comment: DESIGN.md: union of the original areas and the nightly-tuning areas, per the 2026-10-29 lead ruling.

result.$comment: DESIGN.md:15; source handbook_core.py:146-147 requires the sign, colon, whitespace and explanation, not just a sign enum.

sample_size.$comment: DESIGN.md:15,39: null is unknown, 0 is known. Source sample() requires type(value) is int; format prevents a decoded 1.0 from passing JSON Schema's mathematical integer definition.

change.$comment: what/ref remain required and nullable. Optional param/profile/from/to/registry_version are nonblank trimmed strings; parameter values retain the registry's decimal-string representation, never float coercions. This is recorded research metadata, not a configuration action.

supersedes.$comment: DESIGN.md:10-11: a new record points to an earlier id. The log validator enforces earlier, unreplaced, same-area and same-subject; this field alone is nullable trimmed text, not a stricter slug.

source.$comment: paper-reflect producer output maps to reflection-runner; paper-reflect is not a stored enum value.

hypothesis_id.$comment: DESIGN.md:21-24: absent or null remains unknown; no registry lookup here.

adr_refs.$comment: DESIGN.md:24; source handbook_core.py:159-167 accepts distinct ADR-\d{4} strings, including Python Unicode decimal digits.

contradicts_adr.$comment: DESIGN.md:25,33: caller routes new contradictions to the lead; the appender sends no messages.

live_stage.$comment: Union of two different stage taxonomies, not interchangeable authorization. northstar@619452ad155a6be131a54ef9c315cdefb43a41bf:docs/decisions/0053-live-lane-automated-evidence-gated.md:117 defines 0 Shadow (stored as shadow); :118 defines 1 Minimum size (stage-1); :119 defines 2 Scale by evidence (stage-2); :120 defines 3 Target size (stage-3). northstar-trading@d02a51c322ac35dab402aac12f421708eef40deb:docs/adr/0011-execution-exits-and-reentry.md:44,122 defines Stage A fixed-entry exit contrast (stage-a); :44,132 defines Stage B reclaim contrast (stage-b); :46 also names Stage 0 shadow and Stage 1. none is the existing no-stage sentinel, not an ADR stage; null/absence means unknown. No stage-n is defined by either ADR. Sources read 2026-10-29.

origin_lane.$comment: Optional, not nullable. research and sim name lanes that are not broker profiles; paper-a/b/c and ibkr-paper identify paper profiles. alpaca and ibkr are legacy coarse values retained for existing records; new profile lessons use the precise paper lane.

bead.$comment: DESIGN.md:30: source accepts nullable trimmed text, not a stricter northstar-trading prefix.

text.$comment: Source text(): nonempty, Python-str.strip()-trimmed strings, no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F. Explicit Unicode whitespace ranges preserve Python's boundary behavior without imposing ASCII-only text.

reference.$comment: DESIGN.md:15-16 and source reference(): local reference or a literal lowercase https:// prefix; protocol-relative URLs and every other scheme refused. No URI/hostname existence or normalization is imposed.

timestamp.$comment: DESIGN.md:14-15 says ISO; source iso_time() accepts exactly datetime.fromisoformat with explicit timezone (including basic/week forms, non-T separators and second/fractional offsets), not only RFC3339 date-time. The custom format must be enabled via core.schema_validator().
